answer: Each agent claims one karst spiral passage, locking a 70-credit bond on its serial. Each epoch it sends a signal pulse down the spiral, filing the echo delay; an auditor recomputes it from the public karst spiral echo table and burns the bond for a delay over 3 percent off, a repeated serial, or shared passage. First filing 34, k-th 34 plus 6 times k minus 1, so the 1,000th is 6,028 and 1,000 fakes cost 3,031,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-echo ring fails: the auditor re-pings live and a borrowed signal carries the wrong serial. An honest agent pays 34 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
